correctness.rationale: The PL orbit model is exact for all symmetric boards with all diagonal squares. Singleton-star intersections are cones with a full-simplex nerve, so the subcomplex is contractible. Its complement consists precisely of perfect-matching top-dimensional simplices attached along entire boundaries, proving the unrestricted integral wedge type, including odd n, no perfect matching, and n=2. Relative integral orientations give the automorphism-module action. The supplied Python checker verifies 1,339 graph patterns and full-board orders through eight without serving as the infinite proof.

value.rationale: A graph-wide geometric fixed-locus classification identifies a natural homotopy rank with perfect-matching enumeration and simultaneously determines an integral symmetry module, not just one finite homology table. It separates strong three-torsion phenomena for ordinary square chessboard complexes from the torsion-free topology of their transpose-fixed spaces and naturally includes graph-board examples with zero, one or many independent sphere classes.
